# Event_Driven_Orbital_Object_Pipeline

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A processing pipeline that consumes asynchronous event streams from neuromorphic sensors (e.g., DVS) to detect and track orbital objects, bypassing conventional frame-based image processing. Highlights the advantage of event-driven sensing for high-speed, low-power orbital surveillance, a core use case for in-network neuromorphic systems.
